data.title: 胡桃 · 无妄坡幽火幻舞
data.description: 【胡桃 · 无妄坡幽火幻舞】夜幕笼罩下的无妄坡古树林间，幽蓝色的磷火在空中静静漂浮。胡桃身姿轻盈地侧立在盘虬卧龙的古木枝头，单手掐诀操控着身边可爱的火灵小幽灵（Boo Tao），嘴角挂着神秘莫测又调皮可爱的狡黠微笑——「阴阳有序，命运无常！往生堂第七十七代堂主胡桃，奉陪到底哦～」
data.action: 侧身轻点枝头，单手结印操控悬浮火灵小幽灵（Boo Tao），嘴角带着狡黠神秘微笑
data.lighting: 幽蓝鬼火冷光与赤红火灵暖光双色交织
data.camera: full-body shot, side view, branch and spirit in frame
data.promptProse: Hu Tao balances sideways on a broad old branch at Wuwang Hill. One hand forms a small guiding sign toward her round, friendly fire spirit while the other steadies her posture against the trunk. Blue wisps hang between the distant trees; The companion casts a warm red edge across her dark director coat, shorts and blossom-trimmed hat. Her flower-shaped red pupils turn toward the viewer with a secretive grin. Show her supported feet, branch and hovering spirit together, with cool forest depth behind them. No lettering.
